name: Hit and Miss
description: A honeycomb brick screen: each course laid with open gaps between the bricks, and the course above bridging every gap.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--ha); mask: @var(--ha); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -50%; top: 0%; width: 164%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--hb); mask: @var(--hb); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --ha: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0% 0% / 64% 21% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0% 63.291% / 64% 21% no-repeat; --hb: linear-gradient(#000, #000) 100% 31.646% / 39.024% 21% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0% 31.646% / 39.024% 21% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 100% 94.937% / 39.024% 21% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0% 94.937% / 39.024% 21% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
